description: Remove a person from a project's register for good, with all their spellings and facts — it cannot be undone, so do it only when the person asked for this very one to be deleted; confirm the name with them first. The journal keeps a line that a person was deleted, without the name. To turn down a PROPOSED person use set_person with state 'rejected' instead, so they are not proposed again. Members of the project who may write only.

id.description: The person, as list_persons returned them.

name: delete_person
